mapper.sql: CASE UA.AUTHORITY WHEN 'USER_ROLE' THEN 'ROLE_USER' WHEN 'ADMIN_ROLE' THEN 'ROLE_ADMIN' ELSE UA.AUTHORITY END AS authority
U.USER_NO AS userNo, U.USER_EMAIL AS userEmail, UC.USER_PW AS userPw, U.NICKNAME AS nickname, U.PROFILE_IMAGE_URL AS profileImageUrl, U.INTRODUCE AS introduce, U.ADDRESS AS address,
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM USER U LEFT JOIN USER_CREDENTIALS UC ON U.USER_NO = UC.USER_NO JOIN AUTHORITY UA ON U.USER_NO = UA.USER_NO WHERE UPPER(U.USER_EMAIL) = UPPER(#{email})

SELECT
FROM USER U JOIN USER_CREDENTIALS UC ON U.USER_NO = UC.USER_NO JOIN AUTHORITY UA ON U.USER_NO = UA.USER_NO WHERE UPPER(U.USER_EMAIL) = UPPER(#{userEmail})

SELECT
FROM USER U LEFT JOIN USER_CREDENTIALS UC ON U.USER_NO = UC.USER_NO JOIN AUTHORITY UA ON U.USER_NO = UA.USER_NO JOIN USER_IDENTITIES UI ON U.USER_NO = UI.USER_NO WHERE UI.PROVIDER = #{provider} AND UI.PROVIDER_USER_ID = #{providerId}

SELECT
FROM USER U LEFT JOIN USER_CREDENTIALS UC ON U.USER_NO = UC.USER_NO JOIN AUTHORITY UA ON U.USER_NO = UA.USER_NO WHERE U.USER_NO = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER WHERE UPPER(USER_EMAIL) = UPPER(#{userEmail})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER ( USER_EMAIL, NICKNAME, PROFILE_IMAGE_URL, USER_ENROLL_DATE, INTRODUCE, ADDRESS, WARNING, USER_STATUS, WITHDRAW, LAST_LOGIN ) VALUES ( #{userEmail}, #{nickname}, #{profileImageUrl}, NOW(), #{introduce}, #{address}, 0, 'Y', 'N', NULL )

INSERT INTO USER ( USER_EMAIL, NICKNAME, USER_ENROLL_DATE, INTRODUCE, ADDRESS, WARNING, USER_STATUS, WITHDRAW, LAST_LOGIN ) VALUES ( #{userEmail}, #{nickname}, NOW(), #{introduce}, #{address}, 0, 'Y', 'N', NULL )
INSERT INTO AUTHORITY ( USER_NO, AUTHORITY ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, 'ROLE_USER' )
INSERT INTO USER_IDENTITIES ( USER_NO, PROVIDER, PROVIDER_USER_ID, ACCESS_TOKEN ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{provider}, #{providerUserNo}, #{accessToken} )
